Thanks again for the time yesterday. To keep momentum on the MAP and the evaluation plan, can we lock in a weekly 45-minute checkpoint for the next 6 weeks? We want to keep these focused: quick status (10m), evaluation readouts (20m), and action item owners & blockers (15m).

I sketched two possible recurring windows to accommodate your team across US/EU:
- Option A: Tue 10:00–10:45 PT / Wed 18:00–18:45 CET (preferred for your evaluation team)
- Option B: Wed 08:00–08:45 PT / Wed 17:00–17:45 CET (fallback)

Please reply with which window works (A or B) and who from AuroraBio will own the evaluation readouts each week.

Attached: AuroraMAP_v1.xlsx (draft MAP with proposed milestones and owners) and eval-matrix-draft.pdf for your review.

Internal owners from our side: Marcus will cover integration questions, Marissa will run the eval-readout facilitation, and Dev will manage infra/QoS items. Soojin is copied to track calendar ownership.

If either option is a hard no on your side, propose two 1-hour windows and we’ll try to split the difference.

Thanks —
